acceptance_criteria_verified.name: Dedicated Executive Club Management Menu and Screen
acceptance_criteria_verified.evidence: Registered 'Hồ Sơ & Ban Cán Sự CLB' (nav-captain-profile-manage) in group-captain. Added dedicated tab screen #tab-club-profile-manage featuring Breadcrumbs, Header Quick Actions, Card 1 (General Info & Slogan), Card 2 (Executive Leaders Roster), and Card 3 (Announcements Feed). Verified in Mantis & Classic Sport sidebars.

acceptance_criteria_verified.name: Integrated Leadership Roster, Club Slogan & Announcements Hub
acceptance_criteria_verified.evidence: Synchronized dual-element rendering for Slogan (#admin-club-display-slogan), Leaders grid (#admin-club-executives-grid), and Announcements (#admin-club-announcements-list with 5 filter tabs). Verified Add Leader modal (#admin-btn-add-leader) and Edit Slogan modal (#admin-btn-edit-club-slogan) trigger seamlessly.

acceptance_criteria_verified.name: Role-Based Access Control and Privilege Partitioning
acceptance_criteria_verified.evidence: Strict RBAC enforced: menu is visible only for captain/admin/all roles and hidden for runner. Action buttons (Edit Slogan, Add Leader, Post Announcement) hidden for runner. Backend API endpoints (POST/PUT/DELETE /api/clubs/:slug/leaders, PUT /api/clubs/:slug/profile) strictly return HTTP 403 Forbidden with FORBIDDEN_INSUFFICIENT_ROLE when invoked by runner.
